title: Claude Code hooks
description: A Claude Code session's hooks called over MCP (report, action hook), as a plugin from the plugin directory calls them: answered as /hooks/<event> answers them, through the claude_code pack's adapter. Split from claude_code, which keeps the adapter and the launcher as a plain pack. A server-level service: versioned and pinned with the server by its operator, never turned on, off or versioned per island.
